title: Hamsheer Khuda Hafiz
body:
Sarwar Ne Kaha Rokar Hamsheer Khuda Haafiz
Hum Jaate Hain Marne Ko Dilgeer Khuda Haafiz
Sarwar Me Kaha Rokar Hamsheer Khuda Haafiz
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Bachpan Ka Kiya Wada Ab Mujhko Nibhana Hai,
Sar De Ke Mujhe Apna Islam Bachana Hai,
Nana Ki Bachani Hai Jageer Khuda Haafiz
Sarwar Ne Kaha Rokar..........
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Amma Ke Mere Kurta Pehnao Behan Zainab,
Gardan Ka Meri Bosa Lo Aao Behan Zainab,
Chal Jayegi Gardan Par Shamsheer Khuda Haafiz
Sarwar Ne Kaha Rokar........
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Ghurbat Mein Mujhe Maa Ne Armano'n Se Paala Hai,
Pardes Mein Ab Mujh Par Kya Waqt Ye Aaya Hai,
Lutti Hai Teri Maa Ki Jageer Khuda Haafiz
Sarwar Ne Kaha Rokar........
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Ab Khushk Gale Par Hi Khanjar Wo Chalayenge,
Phir Sar Ko Mere Zaalim Naize Pe Chadha Yenge,
Mil Jayegi Mitti Mein Tasveer Khuda Haafiz
Sarwar Ne Kaha Rokar........
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Wo Zulm O Masaib Hain Seh Roz Ke Pyaase Parz
Kya Kya Na Sitam Tote Ahmed Ke Nawase Par,
Ummat Ne Na Ki Meri Touqeer Khuda Haafiz
Sarwar Ne Kaha Rokar........
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Qaime Bhi Jalayenge Chadar Bhi Utarenge,
Haato'n Ko Tere Behna Rassi Se Bhi Bandhenge,
Is Tarah Teri Hogi Tash-heer Khuda Haafiz
Sarwar Ne Kaha Rokar........
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Masoom Sakina Ko Zaalim Se Bachana Hai,
Sajjad Ko Bhi Himmat Har Haal Mein Dena Hai,
Pehnayenge Jab Zalim Zanjeer Khuda Haafiz
Sarwar Ne Kaha Rokar........
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Us Waqt Falak Roya Us Aan Zamee'n Kanpi,
Wasiq O Muqarrib Jab Sarwar Ki Bhi Royi,
Shabbir Jo Kehte The Hamsheer Khuda Haafiz
Sarwar Ne Kaha Rokar Hamsheer Khuda Haafiz
